dashboard.choosePlatformHelp: Họrọ otu ikpo okwu. Nnyocha ngwaọrụ na nhọrọ ebumnuche ga-adị na ihuenyo na-esote.
dashboard.recentSessionsSimpleHelp: Gaa n'ihu na nnwale na-adịbeghị anya ma ọ bụ mepee akụkọ ya.
dashboard.packagedUnavailable: Ọnọdụ ngwugwu adịghị. N'ọnọdụ mmepe, bido pnpm dev:server.
dashboard.noDevicesMessage: Bido local-server ka ịhụ PC obodo na ngwaọrụ Android ejikọrọ.
dashboard.recentSessionsHelp: Windows nwere ike ịlele CPU/nchekwa usoro. Android Beta na-elele CPU, nchekwa, batrị na netwọk. FPS chọrọ njide PresentMon doro anya ma ọ bụ nkwado ikpo okwu nnwale.
error.failedToFetch: Enweghị ike ijikọ na sava obodo. Gbaa mbọ hụ na sidecar desktọọpụ na-arụ ọrụ, ma ọ bụ bido pnpm dev:server n'ọnọdụ mmepe.
error.unexpectedClientError: Mperi onye ahịa a na-atụghị anya ya.
error.androidSystemScreenMessage: Ekwentị na-egosi Ntọala Android ma ọ bụ ihuenyo sistemụ ugbu a. Mepee ngwa ma ọ bụ egwuregwu ịchọrọ ịnwale, wee pịa Bido Nnwale ọzọ.
history.noRecentSessionsMessage: Bido nnwale Windows ma ọ bụ Android iji mepụta akụkọ ihe mere eme.
history.localOnly: Na-egosi naanị akụkọ echekwara na ngwaọrụ n'ihi na local-server adịghị.
guide.title: Otu esi eji LumaTrace
guide.subtitle: Họrọ Windows ma ọ bụ Android, soro nzọụkwụ ikpo okwu, bido nnwale, kwụsị ya, wee gụọ akụkọ.
guide.mockTitle: Buru ụzọ nwalee ya n'enweghị nsogbu
guide.mockBody: Mock Local Device bụ ngwaọrụ ngosi etinyere. Ebumnuche ya na-emepụta ihe nlele mock nwere akara doro anya ka ị mụta usoro ọrụ n'ejikọghị ngwaike.
guide.pcBody: PC obodo na-edepụta usoro Windows n'ezie. Họrọ otu usoro iji chịkọta CPU na nchekwa. FPS chọrọ njide PresentMon doro anya.
guide.androidBody: Na ekwentị, mee ka Nhọrọ Onye Mmepe na USB debugging rụọ ọrụ, nye PC a ikike, mepee ngwa ịchọrọ ịnwale, họrọ ngwa ahụ ebe a, wee bido nnọkọ.
guide.deviceConcept: Ngwaọrụ: isi mmalite a na-anakọta data, dịka PC a ma ọ bụ ekwentị Android.
guide.targetConcept: Ebumnuche: ngwa, egwuregwu, ma ọ bụ usoro ịchọrọ ịtụ na ngwaọrụ ahụ.
guide.sessionConcept: Nnọkọ: otu ọsọ nlele. Bido ya, lelee ihe nlele, kwụsị ya, wee mepee akụkọ.
support.title: Dozie / Zipu Mperi
support.body: Buru ụzọ nwaa ịmalitegharị n'enweghị nsogbu ma nyochaa ngwaọrụ ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ na nsogbu ahụ adịgide, mepee fọm mperi GitHub a kwadebere.
support.repairDescription: Malitegharịa nchịkọta obodo ma nyochaa ngwaọrụ na ngwa ọrụ ọzọ.
support.repairingHelp: Na-amalitegharị nchịkọta obodo ma na-enyocha ngwa ọrụ na ngwaọrụ ọzọ.
support.repairSuccess: Ndozi agwụla. E melitela ọnọdụ ngwa ọrụ na ngwaọrụ.
support.repairFailed: Ndozi akpaka agwụghị. Ị nwere ike izipu mperi ka e soro ya.
support.submitDescription: Mepee fọm mperi GitHub a kwadebere site n'otu pịa.
support.submitFailed: Enweghị ike imepee ibe mperi GitHub.
support.include: Nkọwa bara uru: ụdị ngwa, ụdị Windows/Android, ụdị ngwaọrụ, ihe ị pịrị, ihe ị tụrụ anya, ihe mere, nseta ihuenyo, na mbupụ nchọpụta e sachara.
support.privacy: Etinyela token, akaụntụ, ụzọ mpaghara zuru ezu, ndekọ raw, faịlụ CSV raw, logcat, bugreport, ma ọ bụ nseta ihuenyo nzuzo.
device.mockDescription: Data nkuzi dị nchebe. Ihe nlele bụ nke e mepụtara ma nwee akara mock doro anya.
device.localPcDescription: Nchọpụta usoro Windows n'ezie na nlele CPU/nchekwa.
session.beginnerBody: Maka nnwale mbụ gị, họrọ Windows, họrọ usoro ngwa na-arụ ọrụ, pịa Bido Nnwale, kwụsị mgbe sekọnd ole na ole gachara, wee mepee akụkọ.
session.platformSubtitle: Bido site na ikpo okwu ịchọrọ ịnwale. LumaTrace ga-eduzi nzọụkwụ ọzọ ma debe ihe nlele ndị na-adịghị ka N/A.
session.platformWindowsBody: Họrọ usoro ngwa ma ọ bụ egwuregwu na PC a, wee bido nnwale. Ọ bụrụ na usoro ahụ apụọ, nnọkọ ahụ ga-akwụsị ma ọ bụ dekọọ nkwụsị doro anya.
session.platformAndroidBody: Mee ka Nhọrọ Onye Mmepe na USB debugging rụọ ọrụ na ekwentị, nye PC a ikike, mepee ngwa ịchọrọ ịnwale, wee pịa Bido Nnwale. LumaTrace na-achọpụta ngwugwu dị n'ihu na akpaghị aka.
session.targetHelp: Ntọala ndabara dị nchebe adịla njikere.
session.runningHelp: Jiri ngwa ahụ dịka ị na-ejikarị ya. Kwụsị nnwale mgbe ị nwetara ọnọdụ ịchọrọ ịtụ.
session.defaultStep1: Họrọ Windows ma ọ bụ Android.
session.defaultStep2: Soro ntụziaka njikọ ma ọ bụ nhọrọ ngwa pụrụ iche nke ikpo okwu ahụ.
session.defaultStep3: Bido nnwale mgbe ahọpụtara ngwaọrụ na ebumnuche.
session.choosePlatformFirstTitle: Họrọ ikpo okwu iji gaa n'ihu
session.choosePlatformFirstBody: Mgbe ịhọrọ Windows ma ọ bụ Android, mpaghara a ga-egosi naanị ngwaọrụ, ebumnuche, na ọrụ mmalite maka ikpo okwu ahụ.
session.windowsStep2: Họrọ usoro ngwa site na Ebumnuche.
session.windowsStep3: Pịa Bido Nnwale. CPU, nchekwa, FPS, na oge frame na-emelite ozugbo mgbe PresentMon dị; ma ọ bụghị ya FPS na-anọ N/A.
session.androidStep1: Na ekwentị Android, mee ka Nhọrọ Onye Mmepe rụọ ọrụ, gbanye USB debugging, jikọọ eriri USB, ma nye PC a ikike.
session.androidStep2: Mepee ngwa ịchọrọ ịnwale na ekwentị.
session.androidStep3: Pịa Bido Nnwale. LumaTrace na-achọpụta ngwugwu ngwa dị n'ihu ekwentị na akpaghị aka.
session.mockHint: Ebumnuche mock bụ naanị maka ịmụ usoro ọrụ. Ha abụghị ihe nlele ngwaọrụ ma ọ bụ ngwa n'ezie.
session.noPlatformDevice: Enweghị ngwaọrụ maka ikpo okwu a ugbu a.
session.androidForegroundTitle: Ngwa dị ugbu a na ekwentị
session.androidForegroundPending: Mepee ngwa na ekwentị, wee pịa Bido Nnwale. Aha ngwugwu ga-apụta ebe a mgbe achọpụtara ya.
session.windowsVisibleAppsHelp: A na-egosi ngwa mepere emepe na mbụ. Ọchụchọ na-ahụkwa usoro dị n'azụ.
session.noWindowsTargetMatches: Enweghị usoro Windows kwekọrọ n'ọchụchọ a. Nwaa aha ọzọ ma ọ bụ melite ebumnuche.
session.exportLogsToReportDirHelp: Android na-echekwa ADB logcat e sachara maka oge nnwale. Windows na-echekwa ndekọ nnọkọ LumaTrace nwere akara oge.
session.noWindowsTargets: Achọpụtabeghị usoro ngwa Windows na-arụ ọrụ. Mepee ngwa ma ọ bụ egwuregwu ịchọrọ ịnwale, wee melite ndepụta ebumnuche.
session.noAndroidTargets: Enweghị ebumnuche ngwa Android ugbu a. Mee ka Nhọrọ Onye Mmepe na USB debugging rụọ ọrụ, nye PC a ikike, mepee ngwa na ekwentị, wee melite.
device.title: Nkọwa Ngwaọrụ
device.subtitle: Ebumnuche na ịdị adị ihe nlele maka ngwaọrụ local-server ahọpụtara.
device.androidHelp: Android Beta chọrọ Nhọrọ Onye Mmepe na ikike USB debugging. Ọ na-akwado njikwa ndụ Bido Ngwa / Kwụsị Ngwa doro anya, nchọpụta ijikọ usoro ọzọ, na ọnọdụ cache/ahụike e sachara. Nlele CPU, nchekwa, batrị, na netwọk chọrọ adb. FPS ka bụ nnwale.
device.pcHelp: PC Beta na-edepụta usoro Windows obodo ma nwee ike ịlele CPU na nchekwa ejikọtara na PID. FPS na oge frame chọrọ PresentMon ma ka bụ nnwale; a na-ekpuchi ụzọ faịlụ executable tupu egosi ya.
device.processPlaceholder: Aha usoro ma ọ bụ PID
device.forceStopConfirm: Nke a ga-amanye ngwugwu ebumnuche ka ọ kwụsị na ngwaọrụ.
device.cacheRefreshed: E melitela cache ngwaọrụ Android na ihe mmalite.
session.title: Nnọkọ Nnwale
session.subtitle: Họrọ ikpo okwu, họrọ ngwa ma ọ bụ usoro ebumnuche, bido nchịkọta, kwụsị ya, wee gụọ akụkọ.
session.deviceNetworkNotice: Ihe ọnụ netwọk n'ogo ngwaọrụ nwere ike ịgụnye okporo ụzọ sitere na ngwa ndị ọzọ.
session.uidNetworkNotice: A na-eme atụmatụ ọnụ ọgụgụ netwọk n'ogo UID site na dumpsys netstats detail.
session.androidNetworkNotice: Netwọk Android na-eji netstats n'ogo UID mgbe ọ dị, ma laghachi na ihe ọnụ n'ogo ngwaọrụ na nkenke e gosiri doro anya.
session.androidFpsNotice: FPS/oge frame Android bụ nnwale ma a na-anwale ya n'oge nnwale site na ọnụ ọgụgụ frame ADB ọha. Ọ bụrụ na Android egosighị data frame kwekọrọ, ọ na-anọ N/A.
session.pcNotice: Nnwale Windows na-anwale FPS/oge frame PresentMon ozugbo mgbe PresentMon dị. CPU na nchekwa ka na-arụ ọrụ ma PresentMon adịghị. Ịdị adị PresentMon: {availability}.
session.sampleIntervalHelp: Ọnụọgụ pere mpe na-anakọta ugboro ugboro ma mee ka eserese dị ndụ karịa, mana na-eji CPU karịa. Ọnụọgụ buru ibu dị mfe ma ka mma maka nnwale ogologo, mana nkọwa eserese na-ebelata. 100 ms bụ ndabara dị mma.
session.reportOutputDirHelp: Họrọ ebe a ga-echekwa akụkọ nnwale. Mgbe nnwale kwụsịrị, LumaTrace na-ede akụkọ HTML, JSON, na CSV n'ime nchekwa a.
session.reportOutputDirUnavailable: Ọ ga-adị mgbe sava obodo kọọrọ nchekwa.
session.reportOutputDirChanged: E melitela nchekwa akụkọ. E malitegharịrị sava obodo n'enweghị nsogbu.
session.simpleSettingsHelp: Ntọala nnwale ndị ọzọ niile na-eji ndabara dị nchebe. Ihe nlele na-efu na-anọ N/A, a naghịkwa etinye 0 n'ọnọdụ ha.

session.stopTargetHelp: Manye ngwugwu ebumnuche ka ọ kwụsị mgbe nnọkọ kwụsịrị
session.experimentalFpsHelp: Mee ka nchọpụta FPS nnwale n'oge nkwụsị rụọ ọrụ
session.presentMonEnable: Mee ka njide PresentMon rụọ ọrụ
session.presentMonEnableHelp: Gbaa njide CSV nwere oge doro anya maka FPS/oge frame
session.presentMonKeepCsvHelp: Debe CSV nwa oge ruo mgbe a kpochapụrụ nnọkọ maka nchọpụta mperi obodo
session.androidFpsNaNotice: FPS na oge frame na-anọ N/A belụsọ ma nchọpụta nnwale mepụta ihe nlele kwekọrọ na ebumnuche. A naghị agbanwe layer na-edoghị anya ma ọ bụ na-efu ka ọ bụrụ FPS.
session.pcCaptureNotice: LumaTrace anaghị ebido ma ọ bụ kwụsị usoro ahọpụtara. Njide PresentMon bụ nnwale. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị PresentMon kwekọrọ adịghị, FPS na-anọ N/A.
session.autoStopped: Ngwa ebumnuche kwụsịrị, ya mere e mechara nnwale na akpaghị aka ma chekwaa akụkọ ezughị ezu ya.

session.waitingForMetricsMessage: Na-ejikọ na ebumnuche ma na-eche ihe nlele n'ezie mbụ. Eserese ga-apụta na akpaghị aka mgbe data rutere.
session.stopDialogMessage: Ịkwụsị ga-ebupụ ihe nlele ma mepụta akụkọ. Ọ gaghị ehichapụ akụkọ mpaghara.
session.createDialogMessage: Nnọkọ na-arụ ọrụ ugbu a. Kwụsị ya tupu ịgbanwee nnọkọ ka nchịkọta wee doo anya.

report.performanceUnavailable: A chịkọtaghị nkezi FPS, ya mere akụkọ a enweghị ike ịtụ arụmọrụ ngosipụta.

packaging.statusUnavailableMessage: Ọnọdụ mmepe nwere ike ịga n'ihu iji pnpm dev:server.
packaging.check1: Local-server etinyere n'ngwugwu na-ejikọ naanị na 127.0.0.1.
packaging.check2: A chọrọ Bearer token maka REST na WebSocket etinyere n'ngwugwu.
packaging.check3: A naghị echekwa token na VITE variables, localStorage, URL, ndekọ, akụkọ, ma ọ bụ nchọpụta.
packaging.check4: Mmalitegharịa sidecar nwere oke, a na-asachakwa nchọpụta ọdịda.
packaging.check5: Agbanyeela ntụgharị ndekọ maka ndekọ ngwa na sidecar.
packaging.check6: Nnwale smoke nchekwa ngwugwu na-enyocha ojiji DB ọzọ mgbe mmalitegharịa.
packaging.check7: A na-emepụta ndepụta ọkwa ngwugwu, ha ka chọkwara nyocha ntọhapụ.
packaging.check8: Njikere ntọhapụ ngwugwu Windows ka egbochiri ruo mgbe ọnụ ụzọ mmepụta zuru ezu.
packaging.check9: Ahazibeghị mbinye aka mmepụta, onye mmelite, notarization, na nkesa ụlọ ahịa.
packaging.rcNotice: Nchịkọta a na-ejikọta njikere sidecar, QA GUI aka, iwu ntọhapụ, na ihe akaebe ọnụ ụzọ RC n'otu nlele e sachara. Ọ bụghị nkwenye ntọhapụ, productionReady ka na-anọ false.
